messages:
emma: FYI customer (Acme) reporting analytics dashboard shows traffic attributed to us-east even though they selected EU region on the shared/org dashboard. They saw a billing spike and flagged it.

acme-cs: attaching screenshot + sample query, we clicked Region: EU, Model: rw-7b, Version: v1, but charts show US traffic. https://img.redwood/acme/snap1.png

devin: thanks — can you paste the raw query URL or network request from the console? need to repro.

acme-cs: here's the request we captured: ```GET https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics?dashboard=org-usage&region=eu-west-1&model=rw-7b&version=v1``` response body is a summary showing buckets for us-east-1.

maya: looking at analytics logs for that dashboard id. I can see the API call hitting analytics-service with region=eu-west-1, but our aggregation job later rewrites region -> us-east-1 for some org-scoped dashboards when cookie org_default_region exists. Noted in logs: `agg:region_normalize org=acme, cookie_region=us-east-1`.

oscar: frontend note: we intentionally send both query param region and include cookie org_region in header for personalization. Backend has precedence rules but a recent merge changed precedence order for shared dashboards so cookie > explicit query param. That sounds like the bug.

devin: can you point to the merge/PR? we need a quick roll-back or patch.

oscar: PR #3127 changed header precedence on 2024-11-09 (intent: respect user org defaults). But that didn't account for dashboard-scoped params. I can revert the change for analytics endpoints.

sre-liz: we should avoid a full revert in prod w/out a canary. Proposed mitigation: add a server-side rule: if request includes `dashboard` param then honor query params first, otherwise fall back to cookie/org header. I can push a config patch and hotfix the aggregator routing in the next 30 minutes.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/analytics-hotfix v20241203.1 -> canary -> prod (ETA 25m) :rocket:

acme-cs: amazing — can you confirm this will reprocess the last 2 hours of aggregated metrics? Our finance team needs corrected billing numbers.

maya: reprocessing is a separate job. I'll schedule a backfill for the dashboard's window once hotfix is live. ETA for reprocess: 4 hours for the 2-hour window (we shard by region). We'll provide updated charts and a CSV export for billing reconciliation.

account-jordan: looping in account team — I'll send Acme the mitigation timeline and an interim credit if numbers change materially.

emma: next steps summary: 1) oscar to merge quick server-side guard honoring dashboard params (in progress) 2) deploy-bot canary rollout 3) maya to run backfill once hotfix is live 4) account-jordan to notify customer + offer credit if needed.

devin: repro steps for eng: 1) create or use a shared dashboard (dashboard query param present) 2) set cookie org_region=us-east-1 3) call analytics endpoint with ?region=eu-west-1&model=rw-7b 4) verify aggregation uses eu-west-1. Short script: ```curl -H "Cookie: org_region=us-east-1" "https://console.redwood.ai/api/analytics?dashboard=org-usage&region=eu-west-1&model=rw-7b"```

oscar: added unit test to assert query param precedence when dashboard param exists. Pushing PR now.

sre-liz: hotfix is live to canary (10% traffic). Monitoring charts for canary show region buckets now honor eu-west-1. No errors so far.

acme-cs: we see correct EU numbers on the shared dashboard now, thanks. Please let us know when backfill completes. :pray:

maya: backfill started, job id bf-20241203-acme-1742. ETA 3h 45m. Will post CSV on the ticket when done.

account-jordan: told customer we'd apply a billing adjustment if reprocessed totals reduce EU->US attribution. I'll hold until we confirm final numbers.

emma: closing the thread here once backfill + billing reconcile done. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
